mapper.select: SELECT id, project_id, agent_id, user_id, node_name, description, system_prompt, temperature, tools, model, create_time, update_time FROM sys_project_agent_node WHERE project_id = #{projectId} AND agent_id = #{agentId} AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_project_agent_node ( project_id, agent_id, user_id, node_name, description, system_prompt, temperature, tools, model, create_time, update_time ) VALUES ( #{projectId}, #{agentId}, #{userId}, #{nodeName}, #{description}, #{systemPrompt}, #{temperature}, #{tools}, #{model}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime} )
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_project_agent_node SET node_name = #{nodeName}, description = #{description}, system_prompt = #{systemPrompt}, temperature = #{temperature}, tools = #{tools}, model = #{model}, update_time = #{updateTime} WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
